subject.title: feat: publish integrations and Crabbox Agent Skill discovery

question: Should Crabbox permanently own and support the draft Agent Skills domain-discovery and cross-vendor AI Catalog endpoints in this PR, or should that publication surface be deferred to a narrower follow-up?
rationale: The patch introduces public discovery endpoints and cross-client distribution claims beyond the existing CLI behavior; code review cannot determine the repository's intended long-term support commitment for evolving draft protocols.

options.title: Land the full discovery contract
options.body: Approve the static domain-discovery and AI Catalog surfaces after the compile fix and real behavior proof demonstrate the generated artifacts and initialization paths.

options.title: Land the core Skill work, defer draft catalogs
options.body: Keep the publishable shared Skill, initialization validation, and client documentation, while moving draft domain-discovery and catalog publication into a separately sponsored follow-up.

options.title: Pause the integration expansion
options.body: Defer the feature until maintainers define the desired agent-discovery distribution and support boundary.

recommendation.title: Land the core Skill work, defer draft catalogs
recommendation.body: Keep the publishable shared Skill, initialization validation, and client documentation, while moving draft domain-discovery and catalog publication into a separately sponsored follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: They currently own the proposed implementation and its follow-up publication checklist, though a repository decision-maker must make the final product call.
